name: Caroli Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Radiologic and Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Caroli Disease

criteria.description: Segmental, saccular or fusiform dilatation of intrahepatic bile ducts demonstrated by imaging
Presence of the 'central dot sign' on imaging representing portal vein radicles within dilated ducts
Recurrent cholangitis, abdominal pain, or jaundice consistent with bile duct pathology

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic segmental intrahepatic bile duct dilatation on imaging plus either the central dot sign or compatible clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily radiologic; liver biopsy may be used to exclude other conditions.

searchTerms: localized bile duct widening in liver
segmental dilation of liver bile ducts
partially enlarged bile ducts inside liver

common.notes: Episodes of fever, chills, and right upper quadrant pain

rare.notes: Malignant transformation risk in longstanding disease

laboratory: Elevated alkaline phosphatase and gamma-glutamyl transferase
imaging: Ultrasound showing cystic dilatation of intrahepatic bile ducts
CT/MRI demonstrating segmental bile duct dilatation with central dot sign
MRCP revealing saccular intrahepatic bile duct cysts
genetic: Mutations in PKHD1 gene associated with Caroli syndrome (related condition)
No definitive genetic mutation identified for isolated Caroli disease
other: Liver biopsy may show bile duct ectasia without fibrosis in isolated Caroli disease

distinguishingFeatures: Caroli syndrome includes congenital hepatic fibrosis
More pronounced portal hypertension and fibrosis
Associated with autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease
Extrahepatic bile duct dilatation rather than intrahepatic
Diffuse bile duct strictures and beading
Progressive cholestasis rather than cystic dilatation

redFlags: Rapid onset jaundice with abdominal pain
Signs of cholangiocarcinoma such as weight loss and worsening liver function
references: Caroli Disease and Syndrome: Clinical Features and Imaging Findings. Radiographics. 2017.
